# FLAMES Game: full reference

> FLAMES Game (https://theflames.app) is a free online FLAMES calculator: enter two names and it works out the classic FLAMES name-game result (Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies or Siblings), showing every step. Built by osLabs (https://osnaren.com). Hosted on Netlify. Last updated 2026-11-21.

FLAMES is a fun paper-and-pencil counting game, not a scientific compatibility test. The same two spellings always give the same result.

## What FLAMES stands for

FLAMES stands for Friends, Love, Affection, Marriage, Enemies and Siblings. Each letter is a possible result.

| Version | F | L | A | M | E | S |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most common | Friends | Love | Affection | Marriage | Enemies | Siblings |
| Alternate wording | Friendship | Lovers | Affectionate / Adore | Marriage | Enemy | Sister |
| Philippines | Friends | Lovers | Anger | Marriage | Engagement | Soulmates |

- F (Friends): an easy-going, loyal friendship.
- L (Love, or Lovers): a romantic match.
- A (Affection): fondness and care, more than friendship but not quite love. Adore or Affectionate in some versions; Anger in the Filipino version.
- M (Marriage): the wedding result.
- E (Enemies): a playful rivalry. Engagement in some Filipino versions.
- S (Siblings): a brother-and-sister style bond. Sweethearts or Soulmates in some versions.

More: https://theflames.app/flames-meaning

## How to play FLAMES (rules)

1. Write both names. Ignore spaces, capital letters and punctuation.
2. Cross out letters that appear in both names, one pair at a time. A repeated letter only cancels while the other name still has a match.
3. Count every letter left in both names. That number is the count.
4. Write F-L-A-M-E-S and count from F up to the count, wrapping back to F if needed. Strike out the letter you land on.
5. Start counting again from the letter after the one you struck out. Repeat until one letter remains: that is the result.

The order of the two names does not change the result. If every letter cancels (anagrams such as Mary and Army), the count is zero; this calculator still completes the count and lands on Affection.

More: https://theflames.app/how-it-works

## Worked examples (computed by the calculator)

- Rahul + Priya: R and A cancel, leaving "hul" + "piy" = 6 letters. Counting 6 strikes S, F, A, L, E in turn. Result: M, Marriage.
- Romeo + Juliet: one E cancels, leaving "romo" + "julit" = 9 letters. Counting 9 strikes A, F, L, S, M. Result: E, Enemies.
- Jack + Rose: no shared letters, so 4 + 4 = 8 letters. Counting 8 strikes L, E, M, F, S. Result: A, Affection.
- Alice + Bob: no shared letters, so 5 + 3 = 8 letters. Result: A, Affection.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is the FLAMES calculator accurate?** It is accurate to the rules of the game: the same spellings always give the same result. It is a game, not a scientific test.

**First names or full names?** Either works. First names are traditional; full names or nicknames change the letters and can change the result.

**Is it free?** Yes. No sign-up, and it works on phones, tablets and computers.

**Are names saved?** Recent pairings stay in your own browser. Global charts count only anonymous results (the result letter and a country code), never names. A share link contains both names so the recipient can see the result.

## API

```
POST https://theflames.app/api/flames
Content-Type: application/json

{ "name1": "Rahul", "name2": "Priya" }
```

The response is JSON: `success` (boolean) and `data` with `name1`, `name2`, `result` (one of F, L, A, M, E, S), `resultMeaning` and a `tagline`. Full reference: https://theflames.app/api-docs
